document_control: This edition is {{ver:version}} of a fixture report, built by {{ver:tool_name}} at version {{ver:tool_version}}. The register below is generated from the bundle, so the set of contributing run artefacts is data rather than narrative.
results: The workload held {{v:rate_primary}} for the whole sustained window, against a measured compute roof of {{v:roof_compute}}, which puts it at {{v:roof_fraction}} of that roof. The corpus behind those figures is disclosed in {{sec:workload}}. Telemetry sat at the configured limit for {{v:cap_busy_samples|n}} busy samples, so the configured limit and not the roof is the thing to talk about. Every point of {{v:rate_sweep}} is published in the table view of {{fig:fig_sweep}}.
workload: Inputs were generated from a template whose varying part sits at the head of every input, so no input repeats and no prefix can be reused. Size was requested in the unit the harness asks in and counted in the unit the engine counts in, and every rate here is quoted on the counted basis. The cache state was read rather than argued: the counter source, the state it resolved to, and what that reading licenses are all rendered from the bundle.
quality_gate: The gate ran the published case set ({{ev:gate_result.cases}}) below and returned {{v:gate_result}}. What a pass licenses, and what it does not, are rendered from the envelope beside the result, because the gap between them is where an overstated quality claim would otherwise live.
reproducing: The harness is published: {{ev:tool.source_url}}. The raw artefacts of the contributing run are named in the bundle, and the corpus can be regenerated from its recipe and seed: {{ev:workload.generation}}.
version_history: Every edition is carried below as a chain, each entry naming the edition it follows, so a missing edition breaks the walk instead of passing unnoticed.
